resources.string: Declared storage settings. These values do not verify provisioned capacity, location or encryption.
Optional nonnegative number in GB. Use a dot for decimals and omit units from the value. Supplied zero differs from not supplied.
Optional literal region text. Empty, whitespace and the word unknown remain supplied text; they do not verify a location.
Optional opaque secret:// reference. Do not paste an encryption key. This editor does not resolve or verify the reference.
Pending storage input is private and has not been saved. Review the original selection and current revision before continuing.
Enter a value or turn off Supply to leave this field not supplied.
Enter a valid number using a dot for decimals and no units.
Enter a number greater than or equal to zero.
Use valid text for this field.
Use an opaque secret:// reference. Do not paste a key.
